QUOTE: "Retry means running the same operation again because the first attempt failed. Here the second call runs unconditionally after the probe succeeds. It is a two-pass size-then-fill pattern, and a failure on the second pass is final."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer concludes this is size negotiation (probe, then fill) rather than retry, and notes the second call is a single unconditional call. It never says "no backoff", "no delay" or "no attempt counter", but it states the core distinction and that exactly one second call follows.
